title: Spanish Paella
description: A traditional Spanish dish made with saffron-infused rice, vegetables, and savory meats.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to absorb before adding the next.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Stir in the paella and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
